ValidationRule.description: Do not allow edits to Closed Opportunities to be modified except by Admin or to update First Opp product Live field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", IsClosed = True, (OR ( ISCHANGED(Amount), ISCHANGED(Previous_Stage__c), ISCHANGED(No_International_Payers_At_Opportunity__c), ISCHANGED(ContractId), ISCHANGED(Pricing_Ticket_Link__c), ISCHANGED(Type), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId) ) ) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can not update a Closed Opportunity. If you need a correction made, please submit a Flywire Ticket via OKTA for your Salesforce Administrator and include the link to this Opportunity.
